areaGuide.title: Living in Setapak – Complete Guide to Room Rental, Condo & Apartment Rental in Kuala Lumpur
areaGuide.description: Setapak is one of Kuala Lumpur's most established and affordable residential areas, offering a wide range of room rental, condominium rental and apartment rental options for students, working professionals, families and long-term tenants. Located in the northern part of Kuala Lumpur, Setapak provides excellent access to major educational institutions, business districts, shopping destinations and public transportation networks. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in Setapak, single room rental, fully furnished condo room, studio apartment, serviced apartment or affordable apartment rental, Setapak offers diverse accommodation choices suitable for different lifestyles and budgets. The area is especially popular among students due to its close proximity to Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman (UTAR) Kuala Lumpur Campus, Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology (TAR UMT), and other educational institutions. Working professionals also choose Setapak because of its convenient access to KLCC, Jalan Tun Razak, Wangsa Maju, Sentul and central Kuala Lumpur. Residents enjoy easy connectivity through Wangsa Maju LRT Station, Sri Rampai LRT Station, Setiawangsa LRT Station, major highways including DUKE and MRR2, and extensive road networks connecting Setapak with other parts of the Klang Valley. Popular lifestyle destinations such as Wangsa Walk Mall, Setapak Central, Melawati Mall, KL Festival City and AEON Big provide convenient shopping, dining and entertainment options. With affordable rental prices, mature infrastructure, universities, commercial areas and a wide range of condominiums, Setapak remains one of Kuala Lumpur's preferred rental locations.
